Serve the store.

USAGE
  srv [global options] <command> [options]

COMMANDS
  serve              Run the server.
  migrate            Migrate the store.

GLOBAL OPTIONS
  -c, --config file  Config file in JSON.
                     default "srv.json" · env SRV_CONFIG
      --flag-debug   Print the value and the source of each option before the
                     command runs.
                     env SRV_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help         Show the help.
